title: SHARP: Cascaded Regex-LLM Architecture for Phishing Detection

contributions.purpose: 兼顾准确/效率/可解释的钓鱼检测
contributions.mechanism: SHARP 三级级联:47 条加权正则先过滤明显样本,模糊内容交 LLM,自适应阈值优化
contributions.evaluation: 1,002 封真实邮件 F1 0.957,超 Feature Ensemble 0.934/CNN-BiGRU 0.915/PhishIntention 0.890
contributions.domain: 网络安全 / 钓鱼检测
contributions.source_quote: Our contributions include: (1) SHARP, achieving state-of-the-art 0.957 F1-score through intelligent combination of regex patterns and LLM analysis

contributions.purpose: 证明混合架构显著提速
contributions.mechanism: 级联选择性调用 LLM,同硬件比时延
contributions.evaluation: 3.2s vs Feature Ensemble 23.8s(7×)/CNN-BiGRU 45.2s(14×),仍 95.2% 准确率
contributions.source_quote: SHARP processes emails 7× faster than feature ensemble methods (3.2s vs 23.8s) while maintaining 95.2% accuracy.

contributions.purpose: 消融验证协同设计+给部署建议
contributions.mechanism: 与 LLM-only、regex-only 消融比较,开源实现
contributions.source_quote: Ablation studies reveal 4.1% improvement over LLM-only and 30.8% over regex-only configurations, validating our synergistic design.

notes: 数据/方法红旗:(1)主对比结果只以图(Figure 1/4)呈现,无主对比数值表;(2)基线错配——PhishIntention 是基于网页截图的视觉钓鱼检测器,却被套用到 1,002 封文本邮件上,"identical conditions" 存疑;(3)数据规模口径不一致:摘要/构建段称 1,002 封平衡邮件(501+501),限制段又出现"Limited dataset (701 samples)"(疑为 70% 训练划分,表述含糊);(4)自建小数据集(PhishTank 抓取,70/15/15 划分)。checklist AI 参与度 C/C/C/D。reject。
